{{Tooltip|W|Won}} 67–59 vs. [[2011–12 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]] }} {{2011–12 Southeastern Conference men's basketball standings}} [[Image:UK National Championship Celebration.jpg|thumb|right|2012 NCAA champions]] The '''2011–12 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Kentucky]] in the [[2011–12 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2011–12]] [[college basketball]] season. The team's [[head coach]] was [[John Calipari]], who was in his third season after taking the Wildcats to their first Final Four in thirteen seasons. The team won the [[2012 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Championship Game|2012 NCAA Championship]], bringing Kentucky its eighth title. The team's 38 wins broke a record shared by 5 teams for the most wins in NCAA men's Division I history.{{cite web|title=NCAA Division I Records|url=http://fs.ncaa.org/Docs/stats/m_basketball_RB/2012/DI.pdf|work=pg 6|publisher=NCAA|access-date=10 January 2013}} ==Pre-season== ===Departures=== Former Wildcats [[Josh Harrellson]], [[Brandon Knight (basketball)|Brandon Knight]] and [[DeAndre Liggins]] were all selected in the [[2011 NBA draft]]. Knight was taken No. 8 overall by the Detroit Pistons, Harrellson was selected No. 45 overall by the New Orleans Pelicans while the Oklahoma City Thunder selected Liggins at No. 53. The trio increased UK's total under John Calipari to 8 players selected in the Draft, including 6 in the first round. {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" ! Name !! Number !! Pos. !! Height !!
